points.description: States the verdict FALSE for the statement that the interrupted process is always rescheduled immediately after the interrupt handler completes.

Justifies the verdict by stating that another process can be scheduled on the CPU next instead of the interrupted process, for example because the interrupted process's time slice has expired. Equivalent wording or another valid reason for a different process being scheduled earns the mark. A bare 'False' with no valid justification earns no mark for this point.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the verdict FALSE (P1) and a valid justification that another process may run next, such as time-slice expiry (P2). A correct verdict with no valid justification gets 1 mark. A justification that does not support FALSE, or a TRUE verdict, gets no marks.
